create_renderer: create a Renderer instance to render 3D scenes in the Habitat-Sim simulation environment
create_camera: create a Camera object to configure viewpoint and projection for scene rendering
create_render_target: create a RenderTarget to specify the output buffer for rendered frames
configure_lighting: configure scene lighting using LightInfo and LightPositionModel from the gfx module
use_debug_line_render: use DebugLineRender to draw debug lines and visualizations in the simulation
